title: Factorized task × layer KanAdapter codes
hypothesis: A task-factor × layer-factor Mirror code over shared KAN parents reconstructs heldout task-layer adapter functions at lower complete bytes than independent adapters and beats native shared-hypernetwork/task-layer coefficient controls.

world.teacher: shared analytic parent functions with rank-2 multiplicatively separable task×layer coefficients

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native factor/hypernetwork alias or storage/quality gate failure.

controls: Mirror separate task and layer factors
success_gate: heldout nRMSE <=0.02, at least 25% fewer full bytes than independent pair adapters, and strict quality/byte advantage over native shared hypernetwork coefficient tensor.
failure_gate: FAIL if native task-layer factors match Mirror or storage/quality gate misses.
boundaries: Synthetic analytic functions only; no speech/foundation/Transformer model claim.
Heldout pair IDs and factor codes remain in inference payload; no factor inference/generalization claim.
No fresh results after exact native factor alias or gate miss.
